description: Source code for a retryable iterator class handling gRPC streaming responses for ExecutePlan in Spark SQL Connect client, including reattachment and resource management.

classes.name: ExecutePlanResponseReattachableIterator
classes.description: A retryable, reattachable iterator for handling streaming ExecutePlan responses over gRPC, with resource management and error handling.

methods.name: retry
methods.description: Retries a function with exponential backoff according to the retryHandler.

methods.name: innerIterator
methods.description: Returns the current underlying iterator as a Scala iterator.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Retrieves the next ExecutePlanResponse, handling reattachment and errors.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if there are more responses, triggering reattachment if needed.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Releases resources and closes the iterator.

methods.name: releaseUntil
methods.description: Asynchronously informs the server to release buffered responses up to a specific response ID.

methods.name: releaseAll
methods.description: Informs the server to release all buffered responses and marks the stream as complete.

methods.name: callIter
methods.description: Calls next() or hasNext() on the underlying iterator with retry logic, handling reattachment if the handle is invalid.

methods.name: createRetryingReleaseExecuteResponseObserver
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous observer for release RPCs that retries on failure.

methods.name: createReattachExecuteRequest
methods.description: Builds a reattach request with the last response ID.

methods.name: createReleaseExecuteRequest
methods.description: Builds a release request, either to release up to a specific response ID or all responses.
